title: USB setup role
contract: Push 1 is described as automatically recognized when connected over USB while Live is running, without manual driver or Settings setup. Accepted platform, firmware, enumeration, recovery and latency remain unknown.

title: Browse navigation and load
contract: Browse opens a column browser; In/Out shifts hierarchy, Selection/State buttons navigate, encoders scroll and Shift up/down pages. Text distinguishes selected preset load from device default load and already-loaded next-entry behavior; no figure-derived button identity or exact light color is imposed.

title: Browse context filtering
contract: Push 1 browsing depends on selected instrument/effect context; an empty MIDI track shows available device families. Only currently loadable folders are visible, with sample-only locations described for an individual Drum Rack pad.

title: Drum layout roles
contract: In Note Mode with Drum Rack, the chapter describes Loop Selector sections for play/sequence/length, a velocity layout and full-grid playing. Note-based switching/momentary access is described, but the separate Layout wording is unresolved; no physical pad map or complete transition table is adopted.

title: Drum pad bank and silent selection
contract: Touch strip and Octave controls navigate Drum Rack pads, with Shift finer movement; Select plus pad selects without playing. Exact pad indices, MIDI notes and pressure response remain unknown.

title: Individual drum browsing and copy
contract: Device selection can focus an individual Drum Rack pad for Browse replacement; other pad taps select further browse targets. Duplicate held from source pad to destination replaces destination devices while preserving already recorded destination notes.

title: Drum step gestures
contract: Step taps add notes and start clip playback; tapping occupied steps deletes them, Mute plus step deactivates without deletion, Solo plus pad solos a sound, and Delete plus pad removes its notes within the current loop. Triplet layout leaves some pads inactive; no grid/sample arithmetic follows.

title: Record and overdub controls
contract: Metronome is available for real-time recording; successive Record actions record, stop recording while playback continues, then enable overdub. General count-in/record eligibility and actual recorded notes remain with recording owners.

title: New and workflow modes
contract: Scene Workflow Duplicate captures playing clips into a new scene; New prepares selected-track material instead. Clip Workflow Duplicate/New operates on selected clip/track while other tracks continue, with Shift-Duplicate scene behavior. Seamless wording supplies no transition tolerance.

title: Fixed Length controls
contract: Fixed Length selects predetermined new-clip length, holding it opens length choice; disabled recording runs until a documented stop action. Enabling during record stops writing and loops the preceding span according to setting, without a beat/sample endpoint law.

title: Repeat and swing roles
contract: Repeat produces repeated held-pad notes, with rate via Scene/Grid and state/settings remembered per track. A short press latches while a hold is momentary; pressure and Swing influence output. No force curve, note rate or swing calculation is supplied.

title: Quantize entry and scope
contract: Quantize applies selected clip note quantization; holding exposes Swing Amount, Quantize To/Amount and Record Quantize. Quantize plus drum pad narrows scope to that drum. Numeric quantization and record-grid enums retain existing owners.

title: Pitched pad and scale layouts
contract: Instrument Note Mode offers pitched playing and loop controls; Scales selects key/scale and Fixed/In Key/Chromatic/layout options. Scale options are described as saved with Set. Scales is ineligible for Drum Rack or Session context; no note-number map, tuning or default key law is prescribed.

title: Melodic step and loop layout
contract: Note switches to melodic step layouts, rows represent chosen pitches and columns selected grid steps. Held Note exposes loop controls and Shift-Note locks them per track; Octave/touch strip changes range. Numeric mapping/phase and the 32-note layout remain ungraded.

title: Loop page selection and copy
contract: Loop-length pads select loop span or viewed sequencer page. A locked view need not be the playing page; reselecting loop restores follow, whereas selecting outside loop sets that page as loop. Duplicate-page adds copied notes over existing destination notes; Delete-page clears first.

title: Combined melodic playing and sequencing
contract: Melodic Sequencer plus Notes combines real-time pitch selection with steps. Select avoids playing; a step adds selected notes, holding it exposes contained pitches, and removing a selected pitch removes it from that step. Duplicate adds copied notes without clearing destination.

title: Note navigation and arm context
contract: Left/right selects tracks and MIDI selection is described as auto-arming. Up/down moves scenes, with Scene versus Clip Workflow determining launched scope; source describes immediate Legato-like position continuation. No constructor arm default or timing law is established.

title: Device mode and banks
contract: Device enables parameter encoders; Selection buttons choose devices and State buttons enable/disable the selected device. In/Out reaches additional parameter banks or rack chains. Exact banks/targets, codecs and DSP remain device/rack owned.

title: Mix modes and split pan
contract: Volume, Pan/Send and Track modes select mix controls; Shift refines adjustment, Master selects Main and held group selection folds/unfolds. In split stereo pan, Pan/Send shows value but disables dial, while Track mode offers appropriate pan controls.

title: Automation entry and indicators
contract: Automation toggles Session Automation Arm; Delete plus encoder touch deletes recorded parameter automation or resets unautomated parameter to default. Recorded/overridden parameters have rectangle/bracket presentation; Shift-Automation re-enables overridden automation.

title: Held-step editing and automation
contract: Holding steps exposes note Nudge, coarse/fine Length and Velocity with multistep selection; empty-step edits can create notes and Duplicate copies note settings. Device/Volume modes permit per-step automation even without notes. Exact values/timebase remain unproven.

title: Session entry, clip and stop controls
contract: Session/Note hold gives momentary mode access. Session pad/Scene controls launch corresponding material and Select chooses without launch; Stop mode stops a track and Shift-Stop stops all clips. The selected-track new-record sentence lacks full slot prerequisites and stays context only.

title: Session navigation and overview
contract: Session arrows and modifiers move the controlled region; Shift exposes Session Overview where pads choose larger blocks and scene controls larger scene ranges. Region borders link software/hardware focus; no numeric pad-to-track/scene or viewport oracle is added.

title: User preferences and alternate mode
contract: Held User opens pad/aftertouch response and Workflow preferences; User Mode disables built-in functionality for alternate mapping. Recommended relative-encoder mode and sensitivity/threshold examples supply no complete protocol, force curve or configuration-token equivalence.

title: Touch strip contextual roles
contract: Instrument real-time touch strip controls pitch bend or mod wheel, toggled by Select-tap; melodic sequencing uses note-range navigation and Drum Rack uses bank selection. Real-time expression is not offered in melodic step-sequencer context.

title: Track/effect and common edit entrypoints
contract: Add Track/Add Effect and modifiers expose track-type and insertion-side entrypoints, with selected group context affecting placement. Undo/Shift-Undo invokes Live history, Delete is context-sensitive, Double extends loop material, and Record-New on armed MIDI triggers Capture. Generic history/record/rack semantics stay with their owners.

title: Power/USB and firmware setup context
contract: Push 2 setup describes included power, USB and power-on followed by automatic Live recognition without manual driver/Settings setup. Live updates may prompt firmware update. No firmware bytes, supported version set, updater, deadline or recovery law is specified.

title: Browse columns, preview and load
contract: Browse exposes context-dependent columns/Collections, encoders/arrows navigate and upper controls move hierarchy. Preview toggles browser audition, Shift-Master adjusts preview level and Load loads selection. Instrument/effect/empty-track context filters available content.

title: Drum layouts and Layout hold
contract: With Drum Rack in Note Mode, Layout cycles Loop Selector, velocity and full-grid modes; held Layout exposes alternate controls and Shift-Layout locks them. Octave/touch strip changes drum banks without automatically changing the sequenced subset across layout changes.

title: Individual pad browse and selection
contract: Device focus plus pad and second upper display button selects pad-level Browse. Load changes to Load Next with a previous-entry option; Select-pad avoids triggering, and expanded rack lower controls/arrows select pads without playing.

title: Pad copy and local options
contract: Duplicate source-to-destination replaces destination pad devices but retains its recorded notes. Selected pad offers choke group/transposition; Shift-pad opens custom-color choice saved with Set and shown on Push, not Live. No LED palette, note number or choke/DSP law follows.

title: Drum step editing
contract: Pad selection enables sequencing; steps add/delete notes, Mute deactivates without deletion and Solo solos the sound. Delete can clear pattern/pad notes; Delete on a pad without notes in current pattern removes its devices. Triplet layout has inactive pads; no event/grid equation is supplied.

title: Record, Accent and overdub
contract: Record alternates record/playback/overdub, with metronome/count-in display context. Accent overrides velocity-sensitive playing/step entry and velocity-pad selection; tap latches and hold is momentary. No velocity byte/force curve, countdown or event timing oracle is added.

title: New and Workflow modes
contract: Scene Workflow Duplicate captures playing clips and New omits selected clip while preparing new material. Clip Workflow Duplicate/New narrows to selected track/clip while other clips continue; Shift-Duplicate captures a scene. Seamless language supplies no audio or scheduler metric.

title: Fixed Length and Phrase Sync roles
contract: Fixed Length and held length selector govern new recording span; enabling during record stops writing and loops preceding material. Phrase Sync relates recording start inside the chosen phrase to current song phase, unlike described beginning-of-clip start. No phrase modulo or quantization formula is adopted.

title: Quantize controls and record-swing context
contract: Quantize and held settings expose note-grid, amount, swing and record quantization; pad modifier narrows to that drum. Record Quantize with Swing is described as not applying swing to automatically quantized notes. Algorithms and exact note positions stay with MIDI/groove/record owners or U.

title: Focus-dependent Arrangement recording
contract: Record toggles Arrangement recording when Arrangement is focused; Shift-Record requests it from Session focus. In Arrangement focus Shift-Record instead toggles Session recording. Other selection/recording prerequisites and actual written events retain their owners.

title: Pitched/Scale controls
contract: Instrument Note Mode offers pitched pads; Scale selects key/type, Layout/Direction, Fixed and In Key/Chromatic settings. Scale settings are described as Set-persistent and default-Set eligible; Delete-pad removes same-pitch notes in current loop. No pad-note/tuning/default/velocity equation follows.

title: Melodic sequencer layout and range
contract: Layout selects melodic sequencers; held Layout exposes loop pads and Shift-Layout locks per track. Rows use selected scale pitches and columns chosen grid steps; Octave/touch strip and Shift alter range. No exact note-to-pad or step-time equation is supplied.

title: Loop pages, follow and duplication
contract: Loop pads set span/view; viewed page may differ from sounding page. Reselecting loop or holding Page navigation restores follow, while out-of-loop page selection changes loop. Page Duplicate adds notes over destination and Delete-page clears first.

title: Track navigation and arm context
contract: Lower controls/arrows select tracks; MIDI selection is described as auto-arming and held track control or Record-plus-track manually arms. Up/down has Scene versus Clip Workflow scope and source describes immediate Legato-like continuation. No universal arm/default or timing law is supplied.

title: Device editing and pages
contract: Device mode selects current-track devices via upper display controls; pressing selected control enters Edit with lower parameter pages and navigation for further pages. Leftmost upper control returns to top level. Actual target banks/plug-in support remain separate.

title: Device insertion, mute, reorder and racks
contract: Add Device browses insertable types; instrument loading replaces existing instrument, effects have documented chain-side roles. Delete/Mute plus device and held-control encoder reorder are entrypoints. Rack device unfolding/macros/chain selection has distinct context, with Drum Rack fold state described as software-controlled here.

title: Track/global Mix and split pan
contract: Mix alternates selected-track and visible-track global controls; Track Input/Output exposes routing. Extra return/track navigation, Shift refinement and Master previous-track return are provided. Split pan disables Global dial while Track mode offers corresponding pan controls.

title: Mix-context rack/group expansion
contract: In Mix context, group/rack tracks can be unfolded with their lower display control to expose contained tracks/chains; arrows reach additional contents and Select-pad jumps to its mixer. This is distinct from Device-context Drum Rack unfolding.

title: Automation controls and status
contract: Automation toggles Session Automation Arm; Delete-touch encoder deletes automation or resets unautomated default. Display dots distinguish automated/overridden parameters; Shift-Automation re-enables overridden automation. Numeric default, events, persistence and return timing remain U.

title: Held-step automation and notes
contract: Clip mode held steps expose note Nudge, coarse/fine Length and Velocity including multiple/empty steps; Device/Mix held steps edit per-step parameter automation even without notes. No note-time percentage conversion or generated event law is supplied.

title: Session entry, selection and stopping
contract: Held Session/Note offers momentary modes; Session pad/scene controls launch material, Select-pad selects without launch, Duplicate copies clip and Stop Clip/Mute/Solo have selected-track, held-track and locked contexts. Shift-Stop Clip stops all. New-record selected-track sentence lacks full slot context and stays U.

title: Session Overview access
contract: Held Layout opens Session Overview; Shift-Layout locks and Layout unlocks it. Pads select larger scene/track blocks and scene controls wider ranges. No figure-derived numeric pad/block mapping or LED palette is prescribed.

title: Setup response and brightness controls
contract: Setup exposes Pad Sensitivity, Gain, Dynamics, Display Light, LED Brightness and Workflow. The source describes response curves and a linear-setting recipe, but these supply no force/velocity/LED calibration, numeric hardware output or default-build guarantee.

title: Simpler sample display/control entry
contract: Push 2 sample workflow uses Simpler: empty state prompts sample browsing, loaded waveform/position/zoom controls and Classic/One-Shot/Slicing choices are exposed. Simpler Edit pages, crop/reverse and slice creation/nudge/split/delete are controller entrypoints only; all mode/voice/DSP/sample semantics remain with sample-instrument and conversion/media owners.

title: Clip mode controls and display
contract: Clip opens selected-clip parameters with audio/no-selection prompt, loop/start/end controls, zoom and audio Warp/gain/transpose context. MIDI layouts have Crop and sequenceable-area display/range navigation. Clip View and MIDI owners retain region/edit algorithms; no pad/time or folded-view numeric law is added.

title: Touch strip and User Mode roles
contract: Instrument real-time touch strip selects pitch bend/mod wheel with Select-tap; melodic sequencing changes range and Drum Rack changes bank. User Mode disables built-in roles for alternate mapping; recommended relative mode is not exact configuration-token/codec equivalence.

title: Hardware, firmware and protocol
contract: Accepted hardware/firmware/platform/USB/ports, messages, LED palette/framebuffer, touch/pressure/velocity calibration, pedal polarity, latency and User Mode protocol remain unknown. Source presence and control names are not hardware capability proof.

title: Model and ambiguous source contexts
contract: Per-mode/track/layout defaults, unsupported/empty/selected-slot recording predicates, conflicting button/context wording, model note maps and same-label behavior require evidence. Push 1 source cannot establish Push 2/3 parity.

title: Editing and boundary outcomes
contract: Empty/end/overlap/range/duplicate/choke/note/step boundaries, arbitrary slice placement, quantization, note expression/tuning and admitted malformed controls have no new numerical, refusal or normalization law.

contract: Undo grouping, cancel/rollback, saved override/arm/mode/selection/Workflow/scale/pad settings, defaults, device/clip transfers and reopen migration remain unknown beyond documentary roles.

contract: Recording ownership, event generation, quantization/phase, repeat/swing/pressure response, automation return, engine/sample-rate/block/tempo/transport transitions and synchronization remain ungraded.
